$comment: Source of truth for @kairos-io/design. Edit this file, then run `npm run build`. Names of the theme variables are the ones the decks already use (var(--ink), var(--sub), ...).

console.description: Console screens (Nodes, Node Detail, Build Artifact): a lighter hairline in the light theme. Nodes also uses the dark orange for accentSoft in the light theme.

site.description: kairos.io and hadron-linux.io homepages: a darker raised surface in the dark theme.

hadron.description: hadron-linux.io: Hadron blue instead of Kairos orange.

installer.description: Kairos Installer: a darker code bar in the dark theme.

foundations.description: Foundations deck: a lighter hairline in the dark theme.

family.mono: 'Martian Mono',ui-monospace,'SF Mono',Menlo,'Cascadia Mono',Consolas,'DejaVu Sans Mono','Liberation Mono','Noto Sans Mono',monospace

rules.textOnAccent: ink on Kairos orange, white on Hadron blue

untokenised.$comment: Hex colors the decks use that are not a clear token yet. The check accepts them so a new hex still fails. They are not written to the CSS. Move one into a token when the maintainers decide what it is.

colors.#C94300: Talk Deck: darkest tile of the orange gradient
colors.#F26A2A: Talk Deck: tile outline in the gradient
colors.#7A2800: Talk Deck: dark orange text or fill
colors.#8B889A: Installer: comment color in the cloud-config sample
colors.#6A6879: Installer: muted text in the code sample
colors.#3A2630: Node Detail: fallback of var(--warnBg), differs from the warnBg dark value
colors.#E9A23B: Console: warning amber (CPU diamond, build warning text)
colors.#E04848: Node Detail: red, not the recovery red
colors.#FFF0E8: Index and Console: pale orange tint
colors.#EEEDF2: Foundations and Talk Deck: table row hairline
